title: Whispers from the Liminal — ep. 9 · writ fer rain

nodes.text: WHISPERS FROM THE LIMINAL · ep. 9 · writ fer rain

Percussive taunt on a face long gaunt
Beading up eyelash soft focus grill
Hold that thought hover that drop
Strain every eye muscle.

Soft water slicks sorry skin burdened with troubles
Prickle tickle tense incision
Cold fluid motion cutting surface tension
Tread lightly lift gently collapse.

Excelsior Middle
Say what you will about
What brung you here.

Tandem sideshow conjoined genii
Bad habit of finishing each other’s-
Jung, Freud, Kant, Tesla, Einstein-
Sentence.
